statement: Create new content in color palettes with "New Palette Color"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Remove or clear content in color palettes with "Delete Palette Color"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in color palettes with "Move Palette Color"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.
Use "Extract Palette from Image" in color palettes; the document ends in the state Blender 5.3 produces for the same input and one undo step restores the previous state.

Run the data operation "Join Palette Swatches" on the current selection in color palettes; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Create new content in color palettes with "Add New Palette"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Change a setting, assignment or conversion in color palettes with "Sort Palette"; the new value is stored in the document, takes effect in dependent results, and one undo step restores the previous value.
